pairs.evidence: scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:168 The matrix counts log rows with ran:true as passed although the declared soak gate counts distinct calendar dates, and it never derives the gate's verdict, so a same-day re-run (a state night.test.mjs:171 pins as reachable) inflates the quota and a night that breached the dispatch mandate still reads as passed.

techniques.evidence: scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:166 The gate (at least 14 distinct dates, at least 10 ran) lives only in docs/development/app-master-soak.md and is counted by hand; the code emits a table of row counts with no verdict or margin, and the dispatch abort criterion never reaches it.

scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:160 newRecord never writes scenario, content version or the SOAK_BACKLOG used, so every row splices into one stable name; run.mjs snapshots the scenario per run dir, but the matrix does not read it or refuse a version change.

scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:171 Case counts per family sit beside the rate, but only on non-ran nights: the anomaly families on ran nights (night.test.mjs:46) are never counted, and no family has a denominator, so hand-set `machine` reading zero looks measured.
scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:410 Misses are split by observed owner, including the harness's own control flow, with unclassified kept as a finding for the weekly hand pass.
scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:447 Night health is read through deterministic checks on the record; the property needing judgment (recall-wrong) is left to the documented weekly human read.

scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:262 Cadence is monitored rather than assumed, each night is persisted in one append, and the pure half is tested without a model; the $2 cost-delta abort remains prose and is not computed.

scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:188 The rate is measured with N beside it, and the soak doc states its gate is not uptime, so no dependability decision is drawn from it that would need the any-of-N and all-of-N pair.
scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:441 Cost is recorded for one tenure with no compared arms, so there is no conditioned denominator to choose.
scripts/app-master-bench/soak/night.mjs:427 The soak's verdict is a boolean read from the driver record; this runner calls no model judge.

pairs.registryProposal: The standard assumes a scenario replayed against fixed input, and does not say how scenario identity and version apply to a longevity soak whose input (the repo and backlog) is meant to move between nights.
